mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE role_type = 1) AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM course_study_progress) AS courseActiveStudents, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(progress)), 0) FROM course_study_progress) AS courseAvgProgress, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(study_duration), 0) FROM course_study_progress) AS courseTotalDuration, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_record) AS practiceTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(is_correct), 0) FROM practice_record) AS practiceCorrect, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(is_correct) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) FROM practice_record) AS practiceAccuracy, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_info WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL) AS wikiResourceCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id) FROM resource_info WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL) AS wikiActiveUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_message) AS aiMessageCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM agent_message) AS aiActiveUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens), 0) FROM agent_message) AS aiTotalTokens, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(mastery_score)), 0) FROM knowledge_mastery) AS masteryAvgScore

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_study_progress c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}) AS course_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_study_progress c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.progress >= 100) AS course_finished_count, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(c.progress)), 0) FROM course_study_progress c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}) AS course_avg_progress, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.study_duration), 0) FROM course_study_progress c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}) AS course_study_duration, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_record p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS practice_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.is_correct), 0) FROM practice_record p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS practice_correct_count, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.is_correct) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) FROM practice_record p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS practice_accuracy, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.score), 0) FROM practice_record p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS practice_total_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_info r WHERE r.owner_id = #{userId}) AS wiki_resource_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.file_size), 0) FROM resource_info r WHERE r.owner_id = #{userId}) AS wiki_resource_bytes, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(r.file_size) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 1), 0) FROM resource_info r WHERE r.owner_id = #{userId}) AS wiki_resource_used_mb, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(r.file_size) / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 300.0 * 100, 1), 0) FROM resource_info r WHERE r.owner_id = #{userId}) AS wiki_quota_percent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}) AS ai_session_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}) AS ai_message_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens + m.completion_tokens), 0) FROM agent_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}) AS ai_token_count, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(m.prompt_tokens + m.completion_tokens) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0) FROM agent_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}) AS ai_average_tokens, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(k.mastery_score)), 0) FROM knowledge_mastery k WHERE k.user_id = #{userId}) AS mastery_avg_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_mastery k WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} AND k.status = 2) AS mastery_mastered_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_mastery k WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} AND k.status = 1) AS mastery_in_progress_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_mastery k WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} AND k.status = 0) AS mastery_locked_count

SELECT c.course_id, ci.course_name, c.studied_lessons, c.total_lessons, c.progress, c.study_duration, c.finish_time, c.update_time FROM course_study_progress c LEFT JOIN course_info ci ON ci.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC

SELECT p.knowledge_point_id, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, COUNT(*) AS practice_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.is_correct), 0) AS correct_count, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.is_correct) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) AS accuracy FROM practice_record p LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.knowledge_point_id = p.knowledge_point_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.knowledge_point_id, kp.name ORDER BY practice_count DESC

SELECT p.question_type, COUNT(*) AS practice_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.is_correct), 0) AS correct_count, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(p.is_correct) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) AS accuracy FROM practice_record p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.question_type ORDER BY practice_count DESC

SELECT r.resource_type, COUNT(*) AS resource_count, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(r.file_size) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 1), 0) AS size_mb FROM resource_info r WHERE r.owner_id = #{userId} GROUP BY r.resource_type ORDER BY resource_count DESC
SELECT r.resource_id, r.resource_name, r.resource_type, r.owner_id, r.file_size, r.status, r.create_time FROM resource_info r WHERE r.owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COALESCE(m.intent, 'CHAT') AS intent, COUNT(*) AS message_count, COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens + m.completion_tokens), 0) AS token_count FROM agent_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY m.intent ORDER BY message_count DESC

SELECT m.message_id, m.session_id, m.intent, m.user_message, m.status, m.prompt_tokens, m.completion_tokens, m.create_time FROM agent_message m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT k.knowledge_point_id, kp.name AS knowledge_point_name, k.mastery_score, k.status, k.practice_count, k.correct_count, COALESCE(ROUND(k.correct_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(k.practice_count, 0), 1), 0) AS accuracy, k.last_practice_time, k.next_review_time FROM knowledge_mastery k LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON kp.knowledge_point_id = k.knowledge_point_id WHERE k.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY k.mastery_score DESC, k.update_time DESC
